vminit_selection: using ghcr.io/apple/containerization/vminit:0.47.0; micropod's sandbox is built for vminit 0.42.0

methods.pairing: Engine A/B within round; threshold contrast paired by seed and round. Lower times win, ties separate.
methods.peer_adjusted_delta: Candidate native-minus-peer time minus control native-minus-peer time for the same seed and round.
methods.replication: Two independent native boots per threshold; four measured waves per boot.
methods.all_calls: Equal complete set of offered slots and ordinals in all four cells of each pair.
methods.same_slot_near_p95: Equal client-slot weight; same offer ordinals selected by either engine's 94–96% post-dispatch rank band within slot and round. The band can select different offers across thresholds.
methods.phase_boundaries: Client-observed dispatch through first-byte callback and then through validated response completion. Descriptive elapsed times include scheduling waits.
methods.roles: Slots 0–7 share the client container with a compiler job; slots 8–31 have no compiler job. Role is fixed by the stock fixture.
methods.admission: Every dense window contains at least one matched host and full owned peer observation. One unmatched blocker-free host row may follow the last wave, final matched peer row and post-work capture. Scoped teardown is verified separately.
